name: Shelborn Drummond Ltd
ownership_summary: SPV incorporated 27 May 2022 (SIC 68209, letting/operating of own or leased real estate), registered at Sutherland House, 70-78 West Hendon Broadway, London NW9 7BT. Directors: Brian Rabinowitz, Mark Charles Rabinowitz, Martin Stimler. Person with significant control: Shelborn Edinburgh Ltd (13368052) - 75%+ of shares and voting rights and right to appoint/remove directors.
notes: Named applicant/appellant for 25/04239/PPP and PPA-230-2794 and site owner vehicle for 1 Redheughs Avenue.

name: Shelborn Edinburgh Ltd
ownership_summary: Incorporated 30 April 2021; immediate parent/PSC of Shelborn Drummond Ltd (75%+ ownership and control). Same registered office as the wider Shelborn group.

name: Shelborn Asset Management Ltd
ownership_summary: Group asset-management company incorporated 11 March 2013, registered at 70-78 West Hendon Broadway, London NW9 7BT; publicly presented as the developer/site owner in press coverage of the scheme.
notes: Press names 'Shelborn Asset Management' as the developer; the formal applicant is the SPV Shelborn Drummond Ltd. The precise contractual relationship between the two is not public.

name: Scott Hobbs Planning
notes: Planning agent: prepared the PAN, pre-application consultation, Planning Statement and PAC Report, and acts as agent in the appeal (agent contact Mr Paul Scott; lodged 'Comments on representations' on the DPEA file).

name: studioNWA Architects
notes: Architects for the illustrative design shown in the May 2025 public consultation boards.

name: City of Edinburgh Council
notes: Determined 25/03575/SCR (EIA not required) and refused 25/04239/PPP on 9 February 2026 following the Development Management Sub-Committee's unanimous vote of 4 February 2026 against officer recommendation.

name: Scottish Government Planning and Environmental Appeals Division (DPEA)
notes: Handling appeal PPA-230-2794; reporter Ms Sue Bell; written submissions procedure; target date 18 August 2026.

name: Action to Protect Rural Scotland (APRS)
notes: Principal opposing campaign group; published pre-committee research, called for a Scottish Government moratorium, and lodged representations (with legal authorities including the Finch ruling) in the appeal.

name: The Cockburn Association
notes: Edinburgh civic society; published analyses of the refusal and supports the council's call for national guidance defining 'green data centres' without formally opposing the specific scheme.

name: ERCS Legal Ltd
notes: Environmental Rights Centre for Scotland's legal arm; made written submissions in the DPEA appeal (council commented on its 26 June 2026 submission on 8 July 2026).
